subject: Ops visibility: usage floor, SLA credit & packaging options
messages:
From: Samuel Park <sam.park@alphatech.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: ops-team@alphatech.com
Date: Fri, 10 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Visibility add-ons — need clarity on usage floor & SLA credits

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the dashboards and tracing look promising for our incident workflows. Before we move to procurement, a couple of commercial questions we need answered for our finance and infra teams:

1) Usage floor: our CFO expects a clear minimum commitment for observability add-ons (retention + tracing + advanced dashboards). Can you confirm if there’s a minimum monthly spend for the add-ons when purchased as a bundle vs. ala carte?

2) SLA credits: our SRE lead wants to understand the crediting model if retention or trace ingestion exceeds latency/availability SLOs (we have strict incident response SLAs). Do you provide credits tied specifically to the visibility components or only to the core inference SLA?

3) Packaging: curious if there’s a reduced egress/storage option (e.g., archive-to-cold for traces older than 30 days) to lower unit costs — and how that affects dashboarding/query performance.

We’ve got legal/procurement on standby but want to confirm the commercial knobs before they cut paperwork.

Appreciate a quick run-down and any attachments you can share.

Best,
Sam
Samuel Park
Head of Platform
AlphaTech
[attachment: requirements_alpha_08-2028.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Samuel Park <sam.park@alphatech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 12 Aug 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Visibility add-ons — need clarity on usage floor & SLA credits

Sam — thanks for the clear list. High level answers below and I attached a short pricing appendix that maps options to cost impact.

1) Usage floor: we offer two purchase models for visibility add-ons: a) consumption-first (pay-as-you-go) with an optional monthly minimum to unlock a 12% bundle discount, or b) committed slab (monthly minimum guarantee) that reduces unit price by ~25% and comes with priority ingest/backfill for peaks. Typical mid-market bundles land in the $6k–$18k/mo committed range depending on retention window.

2) SLA credits: Visibility components are covered under the same platform SLA but we have specific remedial credits for retention ingestion backlogs and tracing query latency. The credit schedule is tiered: small incidents (0.5% credit), medium (2%), large (5%), calculated against the add-ons monthly spend (not core inference). We can include a tailored clause for ALP in the SOW.

3) Packaging & archive option: yes — we support a cold-tier archive for traces older than N days (configurable). Cold-tier reduces storage cost by ~60% but adds a 2–6 min retrieval penalty for archived traces. Dashboards will show latest 30/90d hot data; archived queries are supported but slower.

Next steps: I’ll drop a variant pricing PDF (attached) with three scenarios: PayG + optional monthly min, 12-month committed slab, and 24-month enterprise commit with deeper credits. Marissa (cc) will outline commercial concessions we can make for a 12-month commit. Karthik can confirm technical controls for archiving.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_Visibility_Pricing_v3.pdf (PDF)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 13 Aug 2028 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Visibility add-ons — need clarity on usage floor & SLA credits

Hi Sam — quick note on concessions we can offer if AlphaTech commits to a 12-month slab:

- One-time onboarding credit: $8k applied to month 1 (covers migration, dashboard templates).
- Monthly unit credit: 18% off base add-on price for retention and tracing combined (applies if committed spend >= $10k/mo).
- SLA uplift: include a clause for accelerated remediation (targeted 8-hour response) for visibility incidents with a 2% additional credit if we miss that target twice in a quarter.

If you sign a 24-month commit we can move the monthly unit credit to 25% and include two free custom dashboards.

I can put these in a commercial term sheet and return a redline-friendly SOW.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Samuel Park <sam.park@alphatech.com>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Visibility add-ons — need clarity on usage floor & SLA credits

Sam — technical clarifications on archive and cost impact:

- Cold-tier config: we can set an automatic roll-off to cold after 30/60/90 days. Cold objects are stored compressed and deduplicated; expect 40–65% storage savings depending on trace cardinality.
- Query behavior: dashboard time-series/alerts use a hot index (up to N days) — queries that span archived windows run a hybrid execution that hits cold storage and will be slower. For incident retrospectives we recommend a configured on-demand restore window.
- Ingest spikes: with a committed slab we allocate burst capacity (up to 2x baseline) for up to 24 hours without additional charges — helps avoid ingestion-induced credits.

I'll provide a short technical addendum to the SOW describing retention lifecycles and the restore SLA.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
